paragraphs.chinese:
这一集讲的是，父母要学会什么时候应该站出来掌控局面，什么时候又该退到一边。

卢克和曼尼在同一支篮球队，但他们的教练整场比赛都在冲孩子们大喊，还用难听的话骂他们。菲尔试着平静地和教练沟通，杰却直接上前威胁他。教练气得当场辞职，还让杰自己来接手球队。

菲尔以前带过篮球队，觉得这份工作应该交给自己。杰却无视了他，直接让自己当主教练，还把菲尔当成助手。他要求男孩们打得更有侵略性，球队的表现反而越来越糟。菲尔不断给出有用的建议，杰却拒绝听取。

菲尔最后告诉杰，自己已经受够了总被他推到一边。这不仅仅是篮球的问题。之前在家庭烧烤时，杰也抢走了烤架，因为他不相信菲尔能把牛排烤好。杰承认，自己就是喜欢掌控一切，也承认一开始就应该让菲尔当教练。

比赛快结束时，菲尔接管了球队。他设计了一个简单的战术，让曼尼获得本赛季第一次投篮的机会。曼尼差一点就投进了。虽然球队最后还是输了，但孩子们终于开始像一个团队那样打球。

与此同时，克莱尔带亚历克斯去购物，却在遇到几个同学时，让女儿觉得非常丢脸。亚历克斯让她在车里等着，表现得仿佛被别人看到和母亲在一起，是世界上最糟糕的事。

到了篮球比赛现场，格洛丽亚遇到了同样的问题。她为曼尼加油的声音太大，其他孩子开始嘲笑他。曼尼让她下一场比赛不要再来。两位母亲都很受伤，因为孩子们突然像是不再那么需要她们了。

后来，亚历克斯找克莱尔要钱，准备和朋友出去，克莱尔借机报复了一下。她把钱给了女儿，却故意当着所有人的面，用对待小女孩的口气大声和她说话。格洛丽亚采取了不同的方法。她不断谈起自己和莉莉度过了多么美好的一天，曼尼听得开始吃醋，最后主动邀请她来参加下一场比赛。

米切尔依然没有工作，而卡梅隆已经找了一份兼职。米切尔说自己很享受留在家里照顾莉莉，卡梅隆则说自己很喜欢出去工作，但两个人说的都不是真心话。

杰把米切尔介绍给一位成功的商人，对方愿意给他一份工作。卡梅隆在见面过程中说得太多，把气氛弄得很尴尬，但两个人最终还是承认了自己真正的想法：米切尔想念工作，而卡梅隆想念留在家里陪莉莉。

准备离开时，他们不小心把自己锁在了车库里。两个人为了出去按错了控制按钮，开着自己的车反复撞上那个男人的法拉利。米切尔最后接受了这份工作，其中一个原因是，他现在需要赔偿一场极其昂贵的事故。

到了最后，菲尔终于获得了带领球队的机会，米切尔重新回去工作，而两位母亲也意识到，孩子们依然需要她们，只是并不总愿意表现出来。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is about parents learning when to take charge and when to step back.

Luke and Manny play on the same basketball team, but their coach spends most of the game yelling at the children and calling them names. Phil tries to speak to him calmly, but Jay steps in and threatens him. The coach gets angry, quits on the spot, and tells Jay to take over.

Phil has coached basketball before and thinks he should get the job. Jay ignores him, makes himself head coach, and treats Phil like an assistant. He tells the boys to play aggressively, but the team only gets worse. Phil keeps offering useful advice, while Jay refuses to listen.

Phil finally tells Jay that he’s tired of being pushed aside. It isn’t only about basketball. Earlier, Jay also took over the grill at a family barbecue because he didn’t trust Phil to cook the steaks properly. Jay admits that he likes being in control and should’ve let Phil coach from the beginning.

Phil takes over near the end of the game. He creates a simple play that gives Manny a chance to take his first shot of the season. Manny almost scores, and even though the team still loses, the boys finally start playing together.

Meanwhile, Claire takes Alex shopping, but Alex is embarrassed when they run into some girls from school. She asks Claire to wait in the car and acts as if being seen with her mother is the worst thing in the world.

At the basketball game, Gloria has the same problem. She cheers so loudly for Manny that the other children make fun of him. Manny asks her not to come to the next game. Both mothers are hurt because their children suddenly seem to want less of them.

Claire later gets her revenge when Alex asks for money to go out with her friends. She gives Alex the money, then loudly talks to her like a little girl in front of everyone. Gloria takes a different approach. She talks so much about the lovely day she had with Lily that Manny becomes jealous and invites her to his next game.

Mitchell is still out of work, while Cameron has taken a part-time job. Mitchell says he enjoys staying home with Lily, and Cameron says he enjoys working, but neither of them is being honest.

Jay introduces Mitchell to a successful businessman who offers him a job. Cameron makes the meeting awkward by talking too much, but the two of them finally admit what they really want: Mitchell misses working, and Cameron misses staying home with Lily.

As they’re leaving, they accidentally lock themselves in the garage. While trying to get out, they press the wrong controls and repeatedly crash their car into the man’s Ferrari. Mitchell accepts the job, partly because he now has a very expensive accident to make up for.

By the end, Phil gets his chance to lead, Mitchell returns to work, and the mothers realize that their children still need them, even when they don’t always want to show it.
